combined_5_variable_total.memory_budget_note: The existing 50.0 MiB in-memory LRU and 50.0 MiB GPU texture ceilings CANNOT hold all 5 full-depth variables simultaneously. Multi-variable memory arbitration is required in TASK-12D. At most 2 full-depth 3D variables can be resident simultaneously at LOD 0 within budget.

pros: Fits within 50 MiB GPU ceiling for 2 slabs
cons: Two streaming requests per timestep for deep profiles
Slab boundary must not produce visual seam or interpolation artifact
strategy_A.justification: Minimal change from v1.0.0 architecture. Slab seam handling is a known problem with a documented solution (halo voxels at slab boundaries). Fewer risks than changing brick depth size.

cons: GPU texture 25 MiB per variable limits simultaneous variables to 2 within 50 MiB ceiling
Requires changes to shader depth LUT indexing
strategy_B.justification: Wastes GPU memory on empty vertical padding. Not better than strategy A for <64 levels.

strategy_C.justification: Request overhead outweighs granularity benefit for this domain size.

recommended_strategy: strategy_A: 64x64x32 core with 2 vertical slabs for ~50 levels. Must add halo voxels at the vertical slab boundary to prevent interpolation seams.
